resolution: Email30 source template: Runtime28 adds bounded content-free authority timing and actual cold/warm operation counters while preserving every fresh provider, OAuth, commit and disclosure guard. Host138 provides generic authority projections, scoped pure-content caches and current-state batching. Both Kit42 consumers retain the exact published Host134 release-flow bytes and provenance. The detached Email30 release manifest resolves final source and artifacts without self-reference.

email.kit_compatibility: Host138 must be deployed before this App. Both consumers retain exact Host134 Kit alpha.42 with app-owned domain modules. Runtime28 preserves all fresh provider, OAuth, external-image, commit and disclosure guards and Send exact-message review; timing diagnostics never supply authority. App11 has unchanged permissions and declarations apart from its version.

supported_environment.runtime_platform: POSIX with durable private storage and HTTPS

limitations: Operator-managed developer preview, not production Gmail/Outlook parity.
Latency acceptance requires measured current Host and Runtime callback, cached compose and sync-page results; a build alone does not establish those targets.
OAuth configuration, purpose-specific Host gates/keys, reviewed grants and durable Runtime custody are required.
Resource publication for Task/Knowledge integration needs separate reviewed finite or explicitly Host-issued until_revoked consent; technical renewal alone does not grant it.
